mapper.sql: id, tenant_id, connection_id, sync_type, trigger_source, stage, status, dept_count, user_count, tag_count, created_count, updated_count, inactivated_count, issue_count, cursor_info, error_code, error_summary, start_time, end_time, create_by, create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_social_sync_log WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND connection_id = #{connectionId} AND status = 'RUNNING' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_social_sync_log SET status = #{log.status}, stage = 'FINALIZE', dept_count = #{log.deptCount}, user_count = #{log.userCount}, tag_count = #{log.tagCount}, created_count = #{log.createdCount}, updated_count = #{log.updatedCount}, inactivated_count = #{log.inactivatedCount}, issue_count = #{log.issueCount}, cursor_info = #{log.cursorInfo}, error_code = #{log.errorCode}, error_summary = #{log.errorSummary}, end_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{log.id} AND (#{log.tenantId} IS NULL OR tenant_id = #{log.tenantId}) AND status = 'RUNNING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_social_sync_issue (tenant_id, connection_id, sync_log_id, object_type, external_id, issue_code, issue_summary, process_status, retry_count, create_time, update_time, del_flag) VALUES (#{issue.tenantId}, #{issue.connectionId}, #{issue.syncLogId}, #{issue.objectType}, #{issue.externalId}, #{issue.issueCode}, #{issue.issueSummary}, #{issue.processStatus}, #{issue.retryCount}, NOW(), NOW(), 0)
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_id, connection_id, sync_log_id, object_type, external_id, issue_code, issue_summary, process_status, process_action, process_by, process_time, retry_count, create_time, update_time, del_flag FROM sys_social_sync_issue WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND del_flag = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_social_sync_issue SET process_status = #{processStatus}, process_action = #{processAction}, process_by = #{processBy}, process_time = NOW(), update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND process_status = 'PENDING' AND del_flag = 0
